root: ^Before dawn, you are woken up by a strange noise. You carefully slip out of your sleeping bag, making sure Sierra and Marcus don't wake up.
^Your head pointed towards the source of where the noise was, put on your bag, and you marched towards that exact direction.
^Finally, a sense of agency. Those two always held you back. Marcus throughout was a bit of a wimp... As for Sierra, behind all her flashy equipment, is as helpful as a rock.
^"Can't believe we went the long way just to cross the river, even though there was a fallen tree right here."
^You start balancing towards the otherside, just as dappled sunrays outlined what waited for you...

^You're now running, wet and bagless. Marcus and Sierra were with you. Sierra was soaked. Marcus was panting heavily. Their efforts were wild and as though they were prey. You ran with, didn't look back, but heard the same noise as what bought you here. Distant, yet you felt targeted. It prompted everyone to run towards their physical limits and eventually beyond:
^A feral scream. Marcus Collapsed. Sierra turns to see and then trips. Her right wrist takes the fall, her drenched clothing contributing further to the impact.
^Dawn bled through the trees, You access the situation:
^Most of their equipment during the escape.
^For now, you're far enough from the noise.
^"WE'RE GOING TO DIE AND IT'S YOUR FAULT."
^"WOW INSPIRATIONAL SPEECH KING JR JESUS FUCK."
^"Hey Marcus, you hanging in there buddy?"

c-0: ^"Marcus, look, I'll get us out with your help Ok? And yours too Sierra, I saw your compass and I'll need it. But you two are pretty useless right now, so I'll only be able to help with some cooperation.
^Sierra is speechless from both what you said and the naiive confidence.
^"You want my compass to wander off again? How about i keep it, so when you do drown, we won't lose something valuable in the process."
^"Say that to my face you single-celled prick-"
^Marcus leans by a tree, massaging his ankle. He distracts himself by crawling over to a few mushrooms and selectively pick the ones that seem edible.
^Because of the injuries, she is now one-handed and Marcus is now one-footed. Clearly, you need to be the hero of the story.
